segments.name: Health, Wealth & Career
segments.description: Advises employers and institutional investors on health benefits, retirement, investments, rewards and career programs, and delivers benefits administration and technology.
segments.evidence: The Health, Wealth & Career ('HWC') segment provides an array of advice, broking, solutions and technology for employee benefit plans, institutional investors, compensation and career programs, and the employee experience overall.

segments.name: Risk & Broking
segments.description: Acts as intermediary between clients and insurance carriers, advising on risk management and negotiating and placing insurance through a global distribution network.
segments.evidence: We manage our business across two integrated reportable operating segments: Health, Wealth & Career and Risk & Broking.

revenueModel.text: Clients pay commissions on the insurance premiums placed on their behalf and fees for broking and consulting services.
revenueModel.evidence: We derive the majority of our revenue from either commissions or fees for brokerage or from consulting services.

changes.text: In 2024 the company recorded a tax benefit on the disposal of the TRANZACT business.
changes.evidence: a tax benefit from the capital loss incurred on the sale of TRANZACT
